preconditions.description: The input must be a list of exactly three rounds.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round, tuple) and len(round) == 2 for round in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each round must be a tuple containing two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(scores, dict) and 'P1' in scores and 'P2' in scores for scores, _ in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each round must contain a dictionary with keys 'P1' and 'P2' representing scores.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(smoke, bool) for _, smoke in rounds)
preconditions.description: The second element of each round must be a boolean indicating smoke.

preconditions.expression: all(all(char in 'XO' for char in scores['P1']) and all(char in 'XO' for char in scores['P2']) for scores, _ in rounds)
preconditions.description: Each player's score must consist only of 'X' and 'O' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Pete Wins!' if pete_score > phil_score else stdout == 'Phil Wins!' if phil_score > pete_score else stdout == 'Draw!'
postconditions.description: The output must indicate the winner or a draw based on the scores.
